findings.summary: RemoveConnection invokes synchronous disconnect callback before RemoveAt(i). Reentrant removal of same peer causes outer RemoveAt to throw or silently remove next peer without cleanup; cached counters diverge. Detach before lifecycle callbacks or otherwise make removal reentrancy-safe; inspect all cleanup callers.
